name: Eleventy
description: Eleventy is a simpler static site generator that transforms a directory of templates into HTML.
notes: The upstream repository was renamed from 11ty/eleventy to 11ty/buildawesome (the project is now branded Build Awesome (Eleventy)); the npm package is still @11ty/eleventy. GitHub's homepage field is https://build.awesome.me/; the Eleventy docs site 11ty.dev, also listed in the package.json homepage, is used here. firstRelease from the oldest GitHub release (v0.2.2, 2018-01-09) and npm 0.2.0 (2018-01-09). Nunjucks is used here; Eleventy also supports other template languages.
